player_participant_id.desc: Id of the participant data that refers to the player on this PC

player_vehicle_id.desc: ID of the vehicle that player drives. Should match the id listed in participant data.

track_id.desc: ID of the track that is used for this session

session_name.desc: User readable name of the session. Eg. "Qualifying" or "Practice 1"

number_of_laps.desc: Number of laps participants must complete to finish the race
